title: Multiple people, including children, injured in elementary school shooting in Oregon
summary:
Number of people injured at scene was not clear, as police say suspected shooter is dead at the scene

Multiple people, including children, were injured in a shooting at an elementary school…

blocks.text: Multiple people, including children, were injured in a shooting at an elementary school in Bend, Oregon, on Thursday, police confirmed in a press conference.

Police responded to reports of on active shooting at the Silver Rail elementary school on Thursday afternoon. Moments after police arrived on the scene, the suspected shooter, who has not been identified, was shot and killed, according to Bend police communication manager Sheila Miller. It is unclear who fired the shot.
The number of people injured and their status was not immediately clear, police said. Authorities also did not confirm the victims’ identities or ages, but said children were among the victims.
Emergency officials were working to evacuate the elementary school.
